headline: SEA @ KCR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 4.56 at KCR 3.05, with a projected total of 7.61. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SEA: SEA moved +0.05 runs while KCR moved -1.42, changing the projected margin by +1.47 runs. The projected total fell -1.37, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -10.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Logan Gilbert has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Bobby Witt Jr., Randy Arozarena, Maikel Garcia, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Rob Refsnyder, Connor Joe because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
